finding: Routing concentration is the clearest operational risk in this layer
evidence: The capacity-aware policy makes 0 hard-cap breaches, which is the intended result, yet 72.31% of all recommendations land on the busiest tenth of relationship managers, the workload Gini is 0.773, one RM receives 3,216 recommendations and 8 RMs receive none at all. Hard-cap compliance does not automatically create a balanced workload: the preference rules reward the emptiest RM, and in a lightly loaded year that is repeatedly the same person. The routing rules are deliberately unchanged at this stage; this is surfaced as a risk to be decided on, not silently corrected.
